prompt:
Role and task instructions:
You are a helpful, respectful and honest assistant.

User request:
[Goal] You want to rent rock climbing equipment.
[Initial plan] Define Your Needs > Inspect the Equipment > Provide Necessary Information > Pick Up and Return.
[Problem] You find the plan quite vague and miss necessary steps.

Make the plan more comprehensive and concrete. For each step you plan to take, mark with '[Step xx]'.
answer:
[Step 01] **Define the climbing trip.** Decide whether you are climbing indoors or outdoors and whether you will be bouldering, sport climbing, or doing another activity. Record the location, dates, group size, and rental duration.

[Step 02] **Confirm skills and venue requirements.** Check the climbing venue’s equipment rules and any required belay assessment. If you are inexperienced, arrange an instructor or guided session before selecting technical equipment.

[Step 03] **Create an equipment checklist.** List what you already have and what you need to rent. Depending on the activity, this may include climbing shoes, a harness, helmet, crash pads, or ropes and protection. Have the venue or instructor confirm the list.

[Step 04] **Find suitable rental providers.** Contact the climbing gym, local outdoor shops, or guide services. Confirm that they rent the equipment you need, allow its intended use, and maintain inspection and retirement records.

[Step 05] **Confirm sizing and compatibility.** Give the provider your shoe size and relevant harness measurements. Ask staff to confirm that all technical items work together and suit the planned routes, including rope length and belay-device compatibility.

[Step 06] **Check the full cost and rental terms.** Request an itemized quote covering rental fees, deposits, and any additional charges. Review cancellation rules, late fees, damage or loss charges, and any insurance coverage or exclusions.

[Step 07] **Reserve the equipment.** Book the required items and sizes for your dates. Allow enough time for fitting before departure and returning afterward. Obtain written confirmation of availability, pickup hours, and the return deadline.

[Step 08] **Prepare the required information.** Bring the identification, payment method, and deposit requested by the provider. Complete rental agreements and waivers; arrange guardian consent if required for minors.

[Step 09] **Inspect the equipment with staff.** Check ropes and harnesses for cuts, fraying, or damaged stitching; helmets for cracks; and metal equipment for corrosion, deformation, and faulty closures. Ask staff to confirm inspection status and service history. Request replacements for questionable items.

[Step 10] **Check fit and receive instruction.** Try on shoes, the harness, and helmet, adjusting them with staff assistance. Have an instructor verify your ability to use unfamiliar technical equipment; a pickup demonstration does not replace climbing or belaying instruction.

[Step 11] **Document and collect the rental.** Match every item against the inventory, record existing cosmetic damage with the provider, and keep the agreement and receipt. Confirm the emergency contact, return arrangements, and transport or storage instructions.

[Step 12] **Use and care for the equipment properly.** Follow your training and the provider’s instructions. Protect equipment from chemicals, excessive heat, and avoidable damage. Stop using suspect equipment and notify the provider after damage or a significant incident.

[Step 13] **Return the equipment and settle the rental.** Follow the provider’s cleaning and drying instructions, count all items, and return them on time. Report damage or incidents, obtain a return receipt, and confirm the deposit refund and any final charges.
